title: I Rebuilt the Chess Lesson Around the Decision
presenter_rule: Native HeyGen source at 1.0x. Presenter returns in eight short full-frame windows as a re-hook; product proof, kinetic type, diagrams, and illustrations take over between returns. No split-screen crop is permitted.
asset_rule: Use three non-repeating excerpts from one continuous live gameplay capture, five product-detail reframes, and distinct explanatory treatments. Do not loop screenshots, repeat a still as a new scene, or show two product assets at once.
pacing_rule: Editorial target derived from official YouTube retention guidance: fulfill the title and thumbnail promise in the first 30 seconds, change visual form every 3-7 seconds unless evidence must remain readable, and reserve the only extended hold for the final CTA. YouTube does not mandate a fixed cut interval.
music_rule: Authorized The Stream 2.0 stem remains audible below speech with mild ducking only.

summary_scenes.visual: Presenter fills the chess environment with no competing product panel.
summary_scenes.motion: Four short presenter windows are interrupted by kinetic title, decision-fork animation, evidence boundary, and three-state proof preview.

summary_scenes.visual: Presenter fills frame in the chess environment. Small Public browser pilot label only.
summary_scenes.motion: The evidence boundary and proof preview replace a passive presenter hold before product proof begins.

summary_scenes.visual: Live Explore capture: enter mode, play e4, hold on board, guidance, and notation.
summary_scenes.motion: Six-second native product excerpt alternates with the e4 state, notation detail, animated decision flow, and full state.

summary_scenes.visual: The handoff state fills the frame with e4 and the complete product viewport visible.
summary_scenes.motion: Handoff full state, detail crop, transition map, native gameplay excerpt, and presenter re-hook each receive a separate beat.

summary_scenes.visual: Start game, wait for the computer response, then track board, notation, guidance, and candidate moves.
summary_scenes.motion: Native response excerpt, notation detail, candidate-move animation, loop diagram, presenter re-hook, and complete response state alternate.

summary_scenes.visual: Explore, Carry, Respond fill the frame as three sequential states, never simultaneous cards.
summary_scenes.motion: Claim boundary, three individual model steps, complete flow, and kinetic takeaway replace one another every four to five seconds.

summary_scenes.visual: Return to the presenter at full frame for the spoken conclusion and CTA.
summary_scenes.motion: Two short presenter returns are separated by the build-decision card, then the CTA begins under the final spoken line.

summary_scenes.visual: AmaduTown shield and subscribe CTA fill the frame after the spoken CTA lands.
summary_scenes.motion: Soft fade from presenter to the final branded hold.
